updates.new_result: RAKL now has a support-only four-gate diagnostic layer separating corpus coverage, retrieval, witness construction and target transfer. The layer cannot activate authority or change routing.
updates.remaining_gap: No real far-domain corpus has yet been executed under matched retrieval routes, so recall/precision improvements remain unvalidated.

updates.problem: End-to-end analogy failure currently conflates an absent analogue with a retriever miss, and successful retrieval does not always record which lexical/embedding/relational/graph route actually surfaced the candidate.
updates.target: Freeze corpus identity and hidden relevance labels, then score corpus coverage separately from recall@k while recording the retrieval route and rank for every designated analogue.
updates.falsifier: If route attribution adds no diagnostic value beyond ordinary recall/rank metrics on the frozen corpus, collapse it into standard retrieval logging.

updates.problem: A mapper can appear strong when evaluated only against unrelated negatives; surface-plausible near-misses that violate one decisive relation are more discriminating.
updates.target: Construct positive/near-miss packets where terminology and many roles match but one registered invariant, causal direction, regime or unit constraint differs; require a distinguishing-probe certificate.
updates.falsifier: If near-miss packets do not reduce false analogies or improve failure localization relative to random negatives, do not add a dedicated contrastive-negative lane.

updates.problem: Multiple apparent analogies may share one source tradition, template or hidden dependency and therefore should not be counted as independent confirmation of a structural motif.
updates.target: Test domain/source-lineage diversity, shared evidence ancestry and conditional-independence assumptions before treating cross-analogy overlap as corroborating a structural search motif; keep the result proposal-only until target evidence exists.
updates.falsifier: If independence-aware confirmation does not outperform simple witness intersection on frozen false-confirmation worlds, retain only the simpler intersection and provenance record.

updates.problem: Synthetic stage-localization worlds do not demonstrate that RAKL can retrieve real distant scientific analogues with low lexical overlap.
updates.target: Build a frozen real-paper corpus with expert-validated far-domain analogues and near-miss negatives, withheld candidate labels, fixed top-k, and matched lexical, embedding, domain-stripped relational and graph/structural routes.
updates.falsifier: If simple embedding or lexical+embedding retrieval matches all richer routes under the same corpus, model and budget, keep structural routes optional rather than active complexity.

new_prior_art: Analogical Deep Research / CANA mechanism-aligned retrieval and cross-analogy confirmation
ResearchBench inspiration retrieval / composition / ranking decomposition
YARN multi-level abstraction plus structural mapping
relational-overlap analogy evaluation with plausible semantic distractors
updates.consequence: Do not claim stage decomposition, structural analogy retrieval, cross-analogy confirmation, abstraction-assisted mapping or relational analogy scoring individually. Any RAKL novelty claim must remain at the narrower evidence-governance / failure-ledger / authority-boundary level.
